name: 셀러
scene: On a quiet tidal stone terrace at dawn, balanced standing pose, face toward camera, both empty hands open beside her hips and separated from her torso.

casual.scene: On a quiet crescent beach in bright late-morning sun, walking out of ankle-deep surf, both hands relaxed open away from her sides; clear water, distant sea cliffs, complete head and feet visible.
casual.outfit: Fully lined opaque violet two-piece swimsuit with a secure scoop-neck top, broad straps and high-waisted bottoms with full intimate coverage; bare shoulders midriff and legs, one tiny shell bracelet.

casual.scene: At a marine field-station laboratory during rainy afternoon, standing side-on at a shallow specimen tray and sorting empty mollusc shells with two separately visible hands. Cool skylight and a warm task lamp; face visible in profile.
casual.outfit: Ivory sleeveless high-neck fitted work top with violet linen waist apron and high-waisted shorts below crop; bare shoulders arms and a small waist gap, small shell ear studs, no gloves.

casual.scene: In an intimate empty jazz-listening lounge at late evening, seated sideways in a low velvet chair with her torso turned toward camera, placing a headphone ear cup beside her ear with one hand while the other rests open on the armrest. Amber lamps, unlettered records on a shelf, both hands readable.
casual.outfit: Opaque navy satin halter mini dress with secure neckline, an asymmetrical violet wrap panel and a small shell pendant. Bare shoulders upper back and legs, no armor.
